announce_text: Campaigns by product group, each with its own ROAS target
hero_badge: An autopilot for Google Ads, built for online stores
hero_desc: Hontrio reads your products, costs and sales, builds Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns around each product's margin, and tunes them every day, so a sale from ads never costs you more than you make on it.

why_desc: A typical campaign doesn't know what you make on each product. It can bring in sales that cost you money once the ads are paid for. Hontrio puts your margin at the center of every decision.
why_target_hontrio: Worked out from each product's margin
why_products_usual: The whole catalog, low-margin items too
why_products_hontrio: Only the ones that can turn a profit
why_budget_hontrio: Adjusted to results, within your limits
why_searches_usual: Paid for until you notice them
why_reports_hontrio: The profit your ads bring in
how_desc: Setup takes a few minutes. Then Hontrio works every day, and you see everything it does.
how_store_desc: Edinio in one click, WooCommerce with a read-only key, Shopify with your approval. Hontrio reads products, costs and orders with their source.
how_google_desc: Campaigns run in your account and you pay Google directly. Hontrio checks the Merchant Center link and the purchase conversion.
how_plan_desc: Hontrio works out your break-even point, picks the products, and suggests a target and a budget. You choose the goal and launch.
how_pilot_desc: It drops what loses money, scales what earns, and adds negative keywords. With your approval or on its own, within the limits you set.
calc_title_a: How much can you pay for a sale
calc_desc: Move the sliders. This is the math Hontrio runs for every product in your catalog.
calc_goal_keep: you keep {{pct}}% of the profit after ads
calc_profit: You make per sale, before ads
calc_cost_at_target: At Hontrio's target, a sale from ads costs at most
calc_kept: You keep per sale, after ads
calc_breakeven_hint: The minimum ROAS. Below it, every sale from ads costs you more than you make.
calc_target_hint: Above break-even, so there's profit left after ads.
calc_no_margin: There's no profit left to pay for ads. This product stays out of campaigns.

feat_title_a: What a Google Ads specialist does.
feat_breakeven_title: A break-even point for every product
feat_breakeven_desc: From price and cost, Hontrio knows what each product can spend on ads. Whatever can't turn a profit stays out of the campaign.
feat_pilot_desc: Every proposal comes with its reason. Approve it, reject it, or let the autopilot apply what's safe on its own.
feat_mode_approve_desc: The autopilot proposes, you decide. The one exception: it pauses a campaign that hits the loss limit.
feat_mode_auto_desc: The autopilot applies changes itself, within your limits, and sends you a notification.
feat_groups_desc: By category, brand, price range, products on sale or hand-picked ones. Each with its own target and budget.
feat_rules_desc: The autopilot changes things gradually, so Google doesn't have to start learning from scratch.
feat_rule_target: Target ROAS: at most once every 14 days, by 12% at most
feat_rule_budget: Budget: at most once a week, by 20% at most
feat_rule_learning: A new Performance Max campaign is left alone for 6 weeks
feat_rule_loss: At the loss limit, the campaign pauses itself
feat_reports_desc: See what your ads brought in after you paid for them: by day, by campaign and by product.
feat_recs_desc: Products missing a cost price or a GTIN, or disapproved in Merchant Center, sorted by how much they sell.
feat_rec_cost: 8 products sold without a cost price
feat_rec_cost_sub: At stake: RON 26,090 in sales over 90 days
feat_rec_rejected_sub: At stake: RON 8,049 in sales over 90 days
feat_rec_gtin_sub: Google shows offers without a GTIN less often
data_desc: We only access what we need to run your ads. We never sell your data or use it for anything else.
data_store_read: Products, prices, stock, costs and orders, with the source of each sale.
data_store_write: Nothing. We never change your store, and we don't receive your buyers' personal data, apart from their country.
data_ads_read: Campaigns, budgets and their results: cost, conversions, conversion value and search terms.
data_ads_write: We create and adjust Hontrio's campaigns in your account. We only change your existing campaigns if you ask us to.
data_mc_read: Product statuses, prices and how you compare with competitors.
data_mc_write: If you choose, we send product costs and a margin label, so Google can optimize for profit.
data_limited_a: Hontrio's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the
data_revoke: You can disconnect Google at any time in Settings, and access is revoked right away.
faq_desc: Everything you need to know before putting your ads on autopilot.
faq_side_desc: Connect your store and see your first campaign plan in a few minutes.
faq_q1: Do I need a Google Ads account?
faq_a1: Yes. Campaigns run in your account and you pay Google directly; Hontrio only manages them. If you don't have an account, you can create one for free in a few minutes.
faq_q2: Which store platforms does it work with?
faq_a2: Edinio, WooCommerce and Shopify. Edinio connects in one click, WooCommerce with a read-only API key, and Shopify with your approval in Shopify.
faq_q3: What does Hontrio change in my Google Ads account?
faq_a3: It creates and adjusts Hontrio's campaigns: products, budget, target and negative keywords. It only touches the campaigns you already have if you allow it, at launch.
faq_q4: Can I control what the autopilot does?
faq_a4: Yes. In approval mode, the autopilot proposes changes and you decide. In automatic mode it applies them itself, but never beyond your budget cap and loss limit. Every change stays in the log.
faq_q5: What if I don't have cost prices?
faq_a5: You can estimate them as a percentage of the price, for the whole catalog, a category or a brand, and correct them at any time, product by product. Without costs, Hontrio can't work out your break-even point.
faq_q6: I already run campaigns. Won't they clash?
faq_a6: Before launch, Hontrio audits your account: campaigns competing for the same products, the purchase conversion and the Merchant Center link. You choose what stays on.
faq_a7: From your store: products, prices, stock, costs and orders with their source. From Google: campaigns, results and product statuses in Merchant Center. We don't receive your buyers' personal data and we never sell data.
faq_a8: Creating an account is free. You pay Google directly for your ad budget, and you decide how much it is.
cta_desc: Connect your store and your Google Ads account, approve the plan, and the autopilot takes it from there.
footer_tagline: An autopilot for online stores' Google Ads, with campaigns built around each product's margin.
